scope: Independent bounded software and local native Edge loopback checks, no service draft or real click claimed.
clockReproduction: Frozen Swift-produced P48 and P49 JS wrappers, identical test clocks and binding. With a 200ms old-tab wall offset, +40ms changed expired to bound and a +240ms callback changed bound to expired. Both reject a new document, hidden page or work crossing the cutoff.
nativeBoundaries: Native monotonic capture stops at 150ms, read-only confirmation stops at 1 second. Native wall/monotonic drift outside tolerance in either direction fails.
receiverReview: Existing click route retains its exact PID and kernel process birth. An input cannot discover a new recipient. Read-only observation may find an original process after restart, tied to the saved session.
headlessEdge: Six independent ordinary local Chromium process runs. Compact witness bound only the original editor and form among two visible editors. Same-URL full reload, same-URL pushState, replace/restore original editor, replace/restore original form and blur/focus each rejected the stale pin. Compared the pinned P48 and P49 page payloads byte-for-byte.
